critical_question: How does filtering self-proposed API calls by their effect on subsequent-token prediction let a language model learn when and how to use tools, and what do the zero-shot evaluations support within the method's inability to chain or interactively refine calls?
source_locator: Section 2, physical PDF pages 2-4; section 3, physical page 4; sections 4.1-4.2, physical pages 5-8, including inference restrictions and mixed task results; section 6, physical page 9. PDF printed page numbers match physical page numbers.
expected_relation: A few per-tool demonstrations seed calls retained when their returned information improves predictive loss; finetuning on those augmentations teaches tool selection and invocation. Zero-shot gains are task-dependent, not universal; independently sampled calls and restricted evaluation do not establish chained or interactive tool use.
